SELECT ISNULL([Admission Member],0) AS [Admission Member], ISNULL([Return Member],0) AS [Return Member], T1.BranchId AS AdmissionBranch, T2.BranchId AS ReturnBranch
	INTO #AdmissionandReturn
    FROM (
	SELECT
	COUNT(Distinct  MemberId) AS [Admission Member], mi.BranchId
	FROM #MemberInfo mi
	WHERE AdmissionDate = @EndDate 
	AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT MemberId  FROM [program].[TransferReceiveMember]   with (nolock)
	WHERE [TransferReceiveMember].[TransferredMemberId] = MemberId  AND [ReceivingBranchId] in (SELECT branchId from #MemberBranch))
	group by BranchId
	) AS T1 
	  FULL JOIN
    (
	SELECT
	COUNT(Distinct  MemberId)AS [Return Member], mi.BranchId
	FROM #MemberInfo mi
	WHERE ClosingDate = @EndDate 
	AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT MemberId  FROM [program].[TransferReceiveMember]  with (nolock)
	WHERE [TransferReceiveMember].[TransferredMemberId] = MemberId  AND [TransferredFromBranchId] in (SELECT branchId from #MemberBranch))
	group by BranchId
	) AS T2 ON 1 = 1

SELECT 
	t.BranchCode,
	ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.ParentId =13 THEN t.Debit - t.Credit ELSE 0 END),0),0) as [Bank Balance Current Account],
	ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.Code like '1001002001055%' THEN t.Debit - t.Credit ELSE 0 END),0),0) as [Bank Balance SND Account],
	ROUND(ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.GLAccountId = 5 THEN t.Debit - t.Credit ELSE 0 END),0),0) as [Cash In Hand]
	INTO #BankBalance
	from account.GLTransaction t  with(nolock)
	join account.GLAccount a  with(nolock)
	on a.Id = t.GLAccountId
	where  t.BranchCode = @branchId 
	AND (a.ParentId IN (13,24) or a.Id = 5)
	and t.TransactionDate <= @EndDate
	group by BranchCode

	(
	SELECT *FROM #LoanSchedule ls

	where ls.[LoanAccountId] IS  NULL
	AND [DisburseDate] <= @EndDate
	AND (Status = 1 OR  ClosingDate > @EndDate)

antiPatterns.title: Implicit Data Type Conversions
antiPatterns.description: SQL Server is performing CONVERT_IMPLICIT on column expressions, invalidating index seeks and distorting cardinality estimations.
antiPatterns.recommendation: Align parameter and variable data types with the underlying column data types (e.g. check INT vs SMALLINT/TINYINT or VARCHAR vs NVARCHAR).

antiPatterns.title: Temp Tables Created Without Indexes
antiPatterns.description: The procedure creates temporary tables (#) via SELECT ... INTO, which leaves them as heaps with no indexes, forcing sequential scans and joins.
antiPatterns.recommendation: Replace SELECT INTO #temp with explicit CREATE TABLE #temp (...) with a PRIMARY KEY / CLUSTERED INDEX, then use INSERT INTO.

antiPatterns.title: Heap Table RID Lookups
antiPatterns.description: Target tables have no Clustered Index (Heap), forcing costly RID lookups on every row retrieved.
antiPatterns.recommendation: Define a Clustered Index on the primary key or high-frequency lookup columns of the table.

antiPatterns.title: Single Threaded Execution (MaxDOP = 1)
antiPatterns.description: The query plan is forced to run on a single CPU core because MaxDOP is set to 1 at the server, database, or resource governor level.
antiPatterns.recommendation: Consider setting Cost Threshold for Parallelism (e.g. 50) and MAXDOP based on NUMA core architecture rather than forcing MAXDOP 1 globally.
